0022600179.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (2-4, 2-2 at home, on a two-game winning streak) host the Utah Jazz (1-5, on a four-game losing streak), with the Pelicans 11th in the West and the Jazz 14th. This season the Pelicans trail 0-1 in the series after a 120-119 loss in Salt Lake City, and in 2025-26 the Pelicans won 3-0. New Orleans is without Dejounte Murray (personal), Jordan Poole (ankle sprain) and Yves Missi (knee bruise), while Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise).
